Option 2: "گر پر پرواز بخشیدت فلک - همتی کن بال بگشا تا ملک"
Translation: "If the heavens grant you wings to fly, make ambition, spread your wings till the kingdom." So: With divine gift of flight, ambition leads to reaching kingdom. Encouragement to have ambition to achieve greatness.

Translation: "My ambition is clear, my hand is short (limited) - I am a weak ant, yet I went to the kingdom of Solomon." So again about a weak ant (lowly) with ambition reaching great heights.
